name: Amakusa (Japan, town)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Amakusa town emblem in white: a stylised device of a winged top above a ring, like a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Amakusa in Kumamoto Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-03-27.

features.role: Amakusa town emblem — a stylised device of a winged top above a ring, like a stylised character
